costumes.name: Chief Researcher
costumes.description:
Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: I wonder what experiment I should try next!
Now that I've powered up, what kind of experiments do you think I could withstand?
Can you help me with another experiment? I've got a few things I want to test out with my new equipment.
My weapons are the pinnacle of Missilis's technology. Wanna take a look?
Check this out, Cutey! I can pump this much electricity into my weapons!
You've been staring at me this whole time, Cutey. Guess you like what you see?
Cutey! Where are you? Hurry up, or I'll send the drones after you!
I'll be going through the data from all the experiments we ran together, so there's no need to hurry back.
Looks like the power plant's output has dipped a bit. Let's go take a look!
Hmm, I haven't seen this tool before. It must be new.
It's still as noisy as ever in here... Guess that's to be expected with Laplace and Drake around.
I've gained new power, so naturally my research has to evolve too. Can you keep up, Cutey?
Feels like my enhanced parts just got an extra boost!
The output limit went up again? That's pretty good.
Yet another round of enhancement... Now I'm curious just how far the limits can be pushed.
You got me a gift to celebrate my power-up? Thanks, Cutey!
What should I give you in return...? Want a drone or something?
Hmm... If I quantify your gift-giving habits as data... I bet I'd get some interesting results.
Cutey, you've gone from lovely to heavenly! I'm liking you more and more.
Did something go wrong when they outfitted my new parts? Whenever I see you, there's this strange feeling in my chest.
I've only grown fonder of you over time. Now that's a fascinating topic for research.
This is the perfect chance to test out my new weapons.
What's up?
I'll head on over.
Great! I can finally put my new weapons to the test!
I'll be able to collect new data.
Drones, form up!
I'm counting on you, my heavenly Cutey!
Let me recharge for a bit.
Looks like the new weapons recharge pretty fast too.
I'll make a few repairs. It won't take long.
Charging complete!
Charging sequence initiated! Maximum output!
Everyone, ready to hit them where it hurts?
Who's next?
Hehe, I'm feeling great today!
Time to push a little harder!
Ugh!
Ow!
Tsk.
Heh... Looks like I'm the one who needs repairs this time...
I did pretty well this time too, didn't I, Cutey?
